name: page_condition

state.task: Decide about the attached image of one scanned page.
state.collection: archaeological reports and related material from Czech archives, 1920–2020

source: #58 plan, B4 (2026-11-08): defects by aspect, orientation, three condition scores

stained.instructions: Is the paper stained or soiled (spots, smears, rust or ink marks that are not part of the content)?

yellowed.instructions: Is the paper yellowed, browned or discoloured with age?

torn_edges.instructions: Are the paper's edges torn, frayed or ragged?

water_damage.instructions: Does the paper show water damage (tide lines, rippling or washed-out patches)?

folds_creases.instructions: Does the paper show folds, creases or wrinkles?

holes_missing.instructions: Are pieces of the paper missing (holes, lost corners or torn-away parts)?

foxing_mould.instructions: Does the paper show foxing or mould (small brown spots or fuzzy patches)?

faint_ink.instructions: Is the ink or print faint or faded, hard to make out against the paper?

bleed_through.instructions: Does writing or print from the other side of the sheet show through?

smudged_ink.instructions: Is the ink smudged, blotted or smeared over the text?

skewed.instructions: Is the page or its text lines tilted by a few degrees in the image?

rotated_text.instructions: Does any text on the page run sideways or upside down?

blurred.instructions: Is the image blurred or out of focus?

cropped.instructions: Is part of the page or its content cut off at an edge of the image?

uneven_light.instructions: Is the lighting uneven (shadows, glare, a dark binding edge or a curved page)?

criteria.upright: text lines run left to right, the right way up
criteria.cw90: the page is turned a quarter clockwise: text lines run from top to bottom
criteria.upside_down: the page is upside down: text lines run right to left with letters inverted
criteria.ccw90: the page is turned a quarter counter-clockwise: text lines run from bottom to top
criteria.unclear: there is no text, or which way up it is cannot be told

orientation.instructions: Which way up is the page's main text in the image?

criteria: intact: clean, whole and flat paper
slight: minor discolouration, small spots or creases
moderate: clear staining, yellowing, folds or frayed edges
heavy: large stains, tears, water damage or missing pieces
severe: the sheet is broken, lost or ruined in large part
paper_condition.instructions: How damaged is the paper itself?

criteria: intact: everything is crisp and legible
slight: a few faint or smudged spots, everything still legible
moderate: parts are faint, smudged or show-through, readable with effort
heavy: much of the content is hard to read or partly lost
severe: most of the content is illegible or lost
content_condition.instructions: How damaged is the content (the text and the images) on the page?

criteria: none: a clean page and a clean scan
slight: small flaws that will not hinder extraction
moderate: flaws that will cause some extraction errors
heavy: flaws that will cause many extraction errors
severe: extraction is unlikely to work; restore or re-scan first
overall_damage.instructions: Overall, how damaged is this page as an input for text and image extraction (the paper, the content and the scan together)?
